title: Highlights of Bali | Swings, Safaris and Sunset Splendors
highlights: Discover Bali, "the Island of Gods", known for its majestic temples, vibrant forests, breathtaking beaches, and much more.
Soar above lush jungles and breathtaking landscapes on the Bali Swing, enjoying panoramic views and an adrenaline rush.
Snap stunning photos at the Bali Handara Gate, a picturesque entrance framed by lush mountains and stunning scenery.
Witness the Kecak and Fire Dance, a traditional Balinese performance featuring hypnotic chanting and dramatic fire displays against a sunset backdrop.
Explore Bali Safari and Marine Park, where you can see a wide range of animals and marine life in their natural habitats.
overview:
About the Tour:
Home to a myriad of adventure activities and scenic beaches, Bali’s tropical climate, stunning green vistas, cascading waterfalls, and ideal beaches with azure blue waters, make Bali a perfect holiday destination.
From age-old architectural temples to a number of fun activities like the Bali Swing, this tropical paradise offers something for everyone. Witness the charming views of the resting boats, and the colorful sky reflecting upon the golden sand over the pristine waters near the Tanjung Benoa harbor. The sunset views from the Uluwatu Temple, the pleasing sound of the gushing water at Tengenuguan waterfall are simply an unmatchable experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be driven to your hotel in Ubud. Check in and enjoy the day at leisure. You can visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple or stroll through the vibrant Ubud Art Market, where you can find unique handicrafts and souvenirs. Additionally, consider exploring Goa Gajah, the Elephant Cave, known for its intriguing carvings and ancient relics. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kintamani Highlands with Tegalalang Rice Terraces and Tegenungan Waterfall Tour
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for a Bali sightseeing tour. Begin your adventure with a visit to Kintamani village, offering breathtaking views of the active Mount Batur volcano and its serene lake. Explore the stunning Tegalalang Rice Terraces and experience the thrill of the famous Bali Swing, soaring high above the lush jungle canopy. Also, visit the picturesque Tegenungan Waterfall, where you can admire its natural beauty and refreshing mist. Afterwards, you’ll be transferred back to the hotel.

days.title: Day Trip to Bali Safari and Marine Park
days.desc: Today, you'll be transferred to the Bali Safari and Marine Park, home to over 1,000 exotic animals. Begin your adventure with a tram safari, where you can observe lions, elephants, and zebras up close. Enjoy captivating animal presentations and explore the freshwater aquarium to spot a variety of aquatic creatures. Later, experience the vibrant Bali Agung Show. For some added fun and relaxation, dive into the Water Play Zone before being transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour | Arrival in Kuta
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and board the transfer to Bali's iconic Handara Gate, famous for its picturesque backdrop perfect for taking photos. Continue your journey to the Ulun Danu Temple, located on the shores of Lake Beratan, where you can admire its unique thatched-roof shrines. Next, visit Tanah Lot Temple, a temple set upon a black-stone peninsula, known for its dramatic oceanfront setting. Finally, get transferred to your hotel in Kuta and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tanjung Benoa Beach | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak and Fire Dance Show
days.desc: Today, get transferred to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can enjoy various water sports, such as jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides (at your own cost). As the sun goes down, visit the Uluwatu Temple, a magnificent cliff-top temple by the sea. Explore the temple's ancient architecture and enjoy the serene atmosphere. Don’t miss the captivating Kecak and Fire Dance show, a mesmerizing display of traditional Balinese dance and music. Later, get driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Leisure Day in Kuta
days.desc: Spend the day exploring the city at your own pace. You can visit the premier shopping complex, Mal Bali Galeria, or pay your respects at the Ground Zero Memorial, which honors the 202 lives lost in the 2002 bombings. Additionally, enjoy a leisurely stroll along the sandy shores of Kedonganan Beach or Kuta Beach, taking in the breathtaking ocean views. In the evening, you can explore the Kuta Night Market, where you can shop for local souvenirs. Afterwards, return to your hotel.

days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and board the transfer to the airport for your flight back home.
